gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-alexandria: Alexandria keeps its lowercase tall, with short stems above and below and wide terminals that stay open. Snowburst One is the loud one, stencil-cut and punchy, while the sans simply gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-amiko:
Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet, bold and expressive.

Amiko sits beside it with outward-pointing terminals and tall strokes, so the sans-serif feels modern and quiet next to such a loud neighbour.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-bangla: Snowburst One is a stencil display face, cut with wide bridges and a bold, expressive streak. And Anek Bangla, a plain sans, brings wide, barely curled s curves and a short reach up to its ascenders.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-devanagari:
Anek Devanagari has distinctly open letter mouths.

Snowburst One brings stencil boldness above it, so a little extra size on the heading will let its wide bridges stand apart from the tall middle zone below.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-gujarati: Stencil swagger meets friendly openness. Snowburst One cuts bold, tall lowercase with wide bridges, and Anek Gujarati follows with a gaping c opening and lowercase that nearly rivals its capitals.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One has wide bridges and tall lowercase built for attention. Anek Gurmukhi is the plain sans quality here, with big open counters and generous round curves in every small letter.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-kannada: Snowburst One brings expressive stencil cuts, wide bridges and tall lowercase, all of it built to grab attention first. Anek Kannada reads quietly, with a high x-height and terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-latin: Bold stencil energy comes from Snowburst One, with wide bridges and a tall lowercase that makes noise. Anek Latin, a plain sans, holds its tall lowercase near the capitals and keeps its letters open, not curled shut.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-malayalam: Loud stencil letters up top, quiet ones below. Snowburst One has wide bridges and tall lowercase, and Anek Malayalam follows with curves whose tips never touch, so a modest body size is plenty.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia keeps its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook, with capitals only slightly above the lowercase. Snowburst One adds the stencil boldness on top, and the two fill the page with clear separate voices.
